subject: Strategic Ally TechTalks — pilot + joint assets
messages:
From: Tess Randle <tess@forgeops.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Strategic Ally TechTalks — proposal for a co-branded 45m series

Hi Jordan,

Nice to meet you over email — Aleksei and I talked through ForgeOps' new partner outreach and we think a joint recurring 'Strategic Ally TechTalks' series would be a great way to showcase an integration path between ForgeOps' deployment automation and Redwood Inference's private/dedicated runtime.

High-level idea: monthly 30–45 minute livestreams that are technical-first (15–20m product update + 15–20m deep-dive + 10m live Q&A). Each episode gets: a co-branded landing page, a blog-post recap (short technical how-to), and a gated recording + slide deck. We can handle the registration page and promo if Redwood can provide a technical speaker + a short co-authored blog.

Proposed pilot date windows: Nov 29–Dec 10 (US-friendly times) — would you prefer lunchtime PST or late-afternoon ET?

Attached a quick one-pager and a rough sponsorship outline (onepager-spotlight.pdf). Can we confirm: who from your team should be included on logistics (marketing) vs. content/tech (field eng/product)? Also curious on your baseline metrics for success (registrations, MQLs, SQLs, recordings watched).

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30m sync this week to align.

Best,
Tess Randle
Head of Ecosystem, ForgeOps
Attach: onepager-spotlight.pdf
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tess Randle <tess@forgeops.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Oct 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Strategic Ally TechTalks — proposal for a co-branded 45m series

Thanks Tess — this looks promising. Appreciate the clear format.

Quick answers:
- Logistics/marketing: loop in Marissa and Ben (cc'd)
- Content/tech: Neha is our partner engineer and should be the technical lead for the session
- Success metrics: we usually aim for 300–500 registrations on a partner technical webinar, 40–60% attendance, and then a 5–8% demo-request conversion from the follow-up nurture (we can tighten numbers once Marissa builds the campaign).

For the pilot, how about a single-track, hands-on episode on "private inference deployment patterns" — target pilot date Nov 30 at 11:00 PST? If Nov 30 doesn't work on your side, we can move into the first week of December.

Marissa/Ben/Neha — would you take point on the Redwood-side checklist (assets, registration, speaker prep, co-authored blog)? If so I can introduce Tess to our events calendar owner and we can lock a target.

Jordan
Director, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Jordan — Nov 30 11:00 PST works for us, thanks. Attaching a draft agenda and a rough speaker roster so we can align (agenda-draft.md, speaker-slides.pptx).

Draft agenda (high level):
- 11:00 — intro + program context (3m)
- 11:03 — Redwood technical overview: private inference patterns (12m)
- 11:15 — ForgeOps automation demo + live deploy (12m)
- 11:27 — joint walkthrough: tuning for latency and cost (8m)
- 11:35 — Q&A (10m)

Notes/questions from our side:
1) Would Redwood be open to a short pre-send survey for registrants to capture use-case buckets?
2) Recording and transcript: we record and host; would Redwood prefer shared hosting or a copy to your CDN?
3) Promo cadence: we typically do a 3-email invite + two social pulses. Do you have co-op budget for paid promo or is organic enough for the pilot?

I also dropped a placeholder Drive folder link and a HubSpot company link in the metadata so we can start tracking registrations.

Looking forward to partnering.

— Tess
Attach: agenda-draft.md; speaker-slides.pptx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Strategic Ally TechTalks — pilot + joint assets

All — thanks for the context. Quick internal checklist I recommend before we confirm Nov 30: 

1) Legal/Comms: confirm no embargo items in ForgeOps slides; get brand use approval (I can run the one-pager through our brand ops).
2) Security/Trust: ask ForgeOps for SOC2 summary or a short statement on how they handle keys/credentials in demos.
3) Speaker prep: Neha to confirm demo steps and a dry-run slot (I suggest Nov 23 or 24).
4) Campaign setup: Ben to create HubSpot event, registration landing, and nurture sequence (Ben: can you add 3-email cadence + post-webinar nurture?).
5) Assets: request speaker bios, headshots, and a short co-authored blog draft (2–3 paragraphs + code snippet) from ForgeOps by Nov 15.
6) Paid promo: we have a small co-op pool for partner pilots — need a request form from Finance for spend >$1k.

Ben — please start the HubSpot draft and ping me when you have the link so Jordan/Tess can validate. Neha — please propose two dry-run slots and we will lock one. Jordan — I can take the brand/comms lead and review the blog draft.

Marissa
Sr. Partnerships Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
